protocol.initialization: fresh same-seed weights; shared encoder identical to fresh linear anchor; new head initialization
protocol.loss: fixed TRAIN channel-power-normalized complex MSE + .05 magnitude MAE

specification.excludes: FFT/WOLA, features, projection, complex application, normalization, nonlinearities and LFE DSP

protocol.intervention: replace affine operator head with 20->12->20 SiLU MLP; same fixed crop and learning recipe
protocol.pass_rule: both rear channel NMSE<=.10 and dry PCM relative null RMS<=1e-5 on this exact scored crop
protocol.scope: same-crop memorization only; not generalization, source safety or product qualification

scope: one fixed TRAIN crop; single seed; no generalization or product qualification

posthoc_scalar_gain_diagnostic.method: Target-informed independent real scalar per rear channel: gain=cosine/sqrt(energy_ratio); minimum NMSE=1-cosine^2. Numerical diagnostic only, no audio rendered; independent scaling is not a conservation-preserving deployment recipe.
